text: めに　みえて　なくても　べんりな　どうぐが　あちこちに　おちて　います！

structure.jp: めに　みえて　なくても
structure.en: even if they are not visible to the eye

structure.jp: べんりな　どうぐが
あちこちに　おちて　います！
structure.en: are lying all over the place!

patterns.name: 〜なくても
patterns.explanation: なくても means 'even if not'; みえて なくても is short for みえて いなくても. めに みえて なくても = 'even if you can't see them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus いる shows the state left after something happened: the items dropped and are still there. おちて います = 'are lying there'.
